entities.summary: Erica Wheeler is an American professional basketball player for the Seattle Storm of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for the Vinyl of Unrivaled. Wheeler was undrafted out of Rutgers, but eventually made her way into the WNBA in 2015.
